newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes fractionally lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes fractionally lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed fractionally lower on Tuesday with volume lifted by the bond market, bourse sources said.
The 30-share index closed at 581.62, barely below Monday's 581.71.
Volume was 4.41 million dinars against 2.04 million dinars. Turnover in the bond market was 2.75 million dinars.
BTEI bank fell 0.1 dinar to 21.82 dinars.
